vendors.name: Oracle Database / Autonomous AI Database
vendors.tagline: Converged database with analytic views, Select AI, SQL property graphs, vector search and an MCP server.
vendors.verdictNote: Analytic Views are an in-database semantic layer and Select AI reads comments, annotations and constraints, but Oracle docs do not show Select AI reading analytic view definitions.

artifacts.name: Select AI profile attributes: comments, annotations, constraints
artifacts.format: AI profile JSON attributes; annotations need Oracle AI Database 26ai

artifacts.name: Select AI feedback (stored corrected SQL used as hints)
Autonomous AI Database MCP Server
artifacts.format: MCP endpoint, tools defined with Select AI Agent

artifacts.name: Oracle AI Vector Search (VECTOR data type)

metrics.n: Analytic views define base measures over fact columns and calculated measures, for example LAG over a hierarchy.

dimensions.n: DIMENSION BY lists attribute dimensions with hierarchies. CAPTION and DESCRIPTION classifications attach text to views and components.

relationships.n: KEY ... REFERENCES maps fact columns to dimension keys. Select AI can also send foreign key constraints when the constraints attribute is true.

synonyms.n: Profile attributes comments and annotations add table and column text to the prompt. Annotations need 26ai. No synonym list object.

verifiedQueries.n: DBMS_CLOUD_AI.FEEDBACK stores confirmed or corrected SQL in a per-profile vector index and sends similar ones as hints. 26ai only.

nl2sql.n: Select AI generates, runs and explains SQL from a prompt (runsql, showsql, explainsql). Needs an AI profile and an LLM provider.

ontology.n: No object, link or action layer in the Select AI or analytic view docs. Teams combine analytic views with property graphs.

graph.n: Oracle AI Database 26ai supports SQL property graphs and the SQL/PGQ standard, with GraphRAG and graph algorithm packages.

vector.n: VECTOR data type introduced with 26ai. COMPATIBLE must be 23.4.0 or higher. ONNX embedding models can run in the database.

mcp.n: Managed MCP server for Autonomous AI Database (Serverless, Dedicated Region, multicloud). Exposes custom and built-in Select AI Agent tools.

governance.n: Oracle says MCP access honors RBAC, auditing, VPD and redaction. Grants on analytic views specifically are not covered by that page.

openStandard.n: Analytic view DDL is Oracle SQL. Oracle is listed as a participant in the Apache Ossie (OSI) working groups, but no Oracle converter is shown.

offers: Analytic Views: measures, dimensions and hierarchies stored in the database and queried with SQL.
Select AI generates SQL from questions using table metadata, comments, annotations and foreign key constraints from an AI profile.
Select AI feedback stores corrected SQL and reuses it as hints for similar prompts (26ai).
Managed MCP server exposes Select AI Agent tools under database roles, VPD and auditing.
SQL property graphs (SQL/PGQ) and AI Vector Search run in the same engine as the data.
gaps: Oracle docs do not show Select AI reading analytic view definitions as semantic context.
Annotations, feedback and several profile options need 26ai.
No ontology layer. Analytic view DDL is Oracle specific, with no Oracle converter listed for Apache Ossie.
The built-in MCP server is a feature of Autonomous AI Database, not of self-managed databases.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Add comments and annotations to tables and columns, create a Select AI profile with comments, annotations and constraints set to true, and limit it to a known object list. Record corrected SQL with DBMS_CLOUD_AI.FEEDBACK and expose tools through Select AI Agent and the MCP server. Test whether analytic views help generation before relying on them.

snippet.title: Analytic view over a fact table with one time dimension, two measures and one calculated measure
snippet.code:
CREATE OR REPLACE ANALYTIC VIEW sales_av
USING sales_fact
DIMENSION BY
 (time_attr_dim
  KEY month_id REFERENCES month_id
  HIERARCHIES (
   time_hier DEFAULT))
MEASURES
 (sales FACT sales,
  units FACT units,
  sales_prior_period AS
   (LAG(sales) OVER (HIERARCHY time_hier OFFSET 1)))
DEFAULT MEASURE SALES;

vendors.name: Teradata Vantage / VantageCloud
vendors.tagline: MPP analytics platform with an open-source MCP server and Enterprise Vector Store.
vendors.verdictNote: Vantage has no native semantic model object, but Teradata's open-source MCP server adds YAML cubes, a glossary and predefined SQL tools that an agent can call.

artifacts.name: Teradata MCP Server (MIT license)
artifacts.format: Python package (PyPI, v0.2.8 in Sept 2026), YAML tool definitions

artifacts.name: MCP server semantic layer objects (cubes, glossary, prompts, tools in YAML)
Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform (Teradata Cloud on AWS, Teradata Factory)
Tera natural-language workspace (Tera Analyze, Tera Code, Tera Claw)

metrics.n: MCP server cubes declare measures with SQL expressions in YAML. Open-source add-on, not a Vantage object.

dimensions.n: MCP server cubes declare named dimensions with descriptions and SQL expressions. No hierarchy or time grain object.

relationships.n: Cube joins declare join conditions and join type. Optional joins are added only when a requested dimension or filter needs them.

synonyms.n: MCP server glossary terms hold definitions and synonyms. Cubes, dimensions and tools carry descriptions.

verifiedQueries.n: Custom tools are predefined parameterized SQL exposed to agents. There is no question-to-SQL pair store.

nl2sql.n: Teradata lists natural-language agentic analytics for AI Studio (GA Jul 2026) and announced Tera. No SQL generation docs found; MCP server route available.

ontology.n: No ontology or entity-model object in the MCP server docs or the 2026 platform releases.

vector.n: Enterprise Vector Store adds hybrid search, multimodal embeddings and up to 8K dimensions. Generally available from April 2026.

mcp.n: First-party open-source MCP server (MIT). Versions are 0.x on PyPI and the repo states no GA or SLA.

governance.n: MCP server can run queries under each user's own database credentials, keeping existing RBAC and row-level security.

openStandard.n: Cube YAML is specific to the Teradata MCP server. Teradata is not named on the Apache Ossie pages read.

offers: Open-source MCP server with tool groups for queries, data quality, RAG, vector store, feature store and admin.
YAML defines cubes (measures, dimensions, joins), glossary terms, prompts and tools without Python code.
Cubes compile to SQL at run time and reject unknown dimension or measure names before the query is sent.
Enterprise Vector Store for vector and hybrid search, generally available from April 2026.
Per-user database credentials can be passed through, so existing permissions apply to tool calls.
gaps: No native semantic model object in Vantage with metrics, dimensions and joins. Cubes live in the MCP server only.
MCP server is 0.x software; the repo gives no SLA or GA statement.
No verified question-to-SQL store. Predefined tools and prompts are the nearest thing.
Tera natural-language workspace is not in the July 2026 availability list, and SQL generation docs were not found.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Run the Teradata MCP server, define cubes, glossary terms and prompts in YAML, and let an agent call those tools instead of writing free SQL. Use an external semantic layer if you need governed metrics across many tools. Check Tera and AI Studio docs for your deployment before depending on them.

snippet.title: Cube with a dimension and a measure in Teradata MCP server YAML
snippet.code:
sales_by_region:
  type: cube
  description: Sales metrics by region and product
  sql: |
    SELECT region, product, amount AS total_sales FROM sales_data
  dimensions:
    region:
      description: Sales region
      expression: region
  measures:
    total_sales:
      description: Total sales amount
      expression: SUM(amount)

notes.topic: Oracle and analytic views in Select AI
notes.text: Select AI docs list comments, annotations and constraints as prompt metadata. They do not mention analytic views, so whether Select AI uses analytic view definitions is unconfirmed.
Oracle's product page lists the MCP server GA announcement under December 2025. Docs cover Autonomous AI Database 26ai and 19c on Serverless, Dedicated Region and multicloud.
Oracle docs now say Autonomous AI Database and Oracle AI Database 26ai. Earlier names were Autonomous Database and Database 23ai.

Teradata announced the Autonomous Knowledge Platform on 2026-05-07 and general availability on 2026-07-15. Teradata Cloud is on AWS, AI Studio is on AWS and Teradata Factory, and Tera is not in the availability list.
The repo is under the Teradata GitHub organization with an MIT license and 0.x PyPI releases starting August 2025. The pages read do not state GA, support terms or an SLA.
Oracle appears in the April 2026 list of new Ossie working group participants. Ossie reference converters listed in its README cover dbt, GoodData, Polaris and Salesforce, not Oracle or Teradata.
